newsitem.title: UK: Daiwa Europe appoints MD of global secondary bonds.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Europe appoints MD of global secondary bonds.

text.p: Daiwa Europe said on Thursday it had appointed Garry Jones as managing director in charge of Global Secondary Bonds, effective April 28.

He will cover the sales of fixed income products on a global basis, the trading of fixed and floating Euro bonds, including those of emerging markets, and the research functions supporting those activities, Daiwa said in a statement.
The Global Secondary Bond department is part of the newly established Global Bond Unit, an initiative by Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, the statement said.

Jones was formerly head of European sales and global bond research at Banque Paribas. His career has covered sales and trading roles in London and New York and he has recently been active as one of the leading strategists on the implications of EMU for the fixed income markets, Daiwa said.
